title: Constraining Participation: Affordances of Feedback Features in Interfaces to Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying early adopters of ChatGPT to analyze the demographic characteristics (e.g., age, gender, geographic region) and technical expertise (AI/ML experience) of users who submit RLHF feedback, utilizing chi-squared tests to evaluate how interface affordances disproportionately encourage participation from tech-savvy, frequent users.
